card.name: Linking words in gallbladder complication lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'or', 'and', 'as' and word endings right after gallbladder terms such as cholecystitis, cholelithiasis or cholangitis, in warnings about gallbladder disease. The next word is expected to start with 'ch'.

modes.label: Comma or conjunction in a list
modes.description: A comma, 'or' or 'and' following a gallbladder condition, before the next listed condition.
modes.example: There have been postmarketing reports of cholelithiasis (gallstones) resulting in complications, including cholecystitis<< or>> cholangitis and requiring cholecyst

modes.label: Lead-in to the list
modes.description: 'as' or the end of a word just before the gallbladder term list begins or continues.
modes.example: Acute events of gallbladder disease such<< as>> cholelithiasis or ch

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with words starting with 'ch', such as cholangitis or cholecystectomy.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or comma after one gallbladder problem, when another 'ch-' gallbladder term is likely next.
